Falling within the dyadic division (*Dukapaṭṭhāna*), the text applies the system of twenty-four conditional relations (*paccaya*) to the cluster of dyads (*gocchaka*) concerning the defilements (*kilesa*), which originate from the doctrinal matrix (*mātikā*) established in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi*.
